{{Top|leg}}
The '''bio-plasmatic gel torpedo''' was a weapon devised by the [[Qektoth Confederation]], and deployed through the use of a [[Bio-plasmatic gel launcher]]. The gel was heated, and continued to burn until frozen in the vacuum of space, or burnt up in an atmosphere. When attached to the hull or shields of a vessel, the gel attempted to burn through the obstruction to inflict damage on the target. By remodulating a ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], pilots were able to force the gel to detach.
